info.title: JAC Rental Booking Service API
info.description: Standalone microservice handling all rental property booking operations for the JAC platform. Authentication uses Bearer tokens issued by the JAC monolith (Laravel Passport).

get.description: Returns all active amenities. Filter by type_id.
Returns all bookings belonging to the authenticated user, newest first.
Returns full details for a specific booking owned by the authenticated user.

post.description: Calculates the total price for a unit over selected dates including per-night breakdown. Does NOT create a booking or hold. Use this when the user is browsing dates before committing.

Creates a 15-minute date hold on the unit and returns a payment URL. The booking record is only created AFTER the payment gateway confirms payment via the webhook. Call this when the user taps "Pay Now".
Cancels a confirmed booking owned by the authenticated user. Push notification is sent to the user via the monolith bridge.

400.description: Cannot cancel booking in current state

post.summary: Validate and apply a coupon code
post.description: Validates the coupon code against the booking amount and returns the discount details.

get.description: Returns all properties saved to the authenticated user favourites list.

post.description: Adds a property to the user favourites. Idempotent.
Adds if not saved; removes if saved.

get.description: Returns all countries with active status.
Returns active cities. Filter by country_id.
Returns active neighborhoods. Filter by city_id.
Returns a paginated list of active properties. Supports filtering by city, neighborhood, type, and star rating. No authentication required.
Returns full details for a single property including units, reviews, amenities, and settings.
Returns all active rental property types.
Returns full details for a specific unit including amenities and price rules.

get.summary: Get custom price schedule for a unit
get.description: Returns override/seasonal price records for a given unit within a date range.

200.description: List of price records in the requested period

post.summary: Set a custom price for a unit on a specific date
post.description: Creates or updates an override price for a specific date. Used by org managers/staff.
Called by monolith payment system after payment succeeds or fails.

400.description: Hold not found or payment not paid

PriceEstimate.description: Price breakdown and total for booking

PriceRecord.description: A price rule for a unit

PropertyDetail.description: Full property details including units, org, and settings

PropertySummary.description: Compact property representation returned in list views

UnitDetail.description: Full unit details with amenities and price rules

UnitSummary.description: Compact unit representation in property listings

bearerAuth.description: Passport Bearer token issued by the JAC monolith. Obtain via the monolith /api/v1/auth/login endpoint.
